{{- /*
  llms.txt - an industry-standard index of the site for LLM crawlers.

  Contract: docs/BASE-THEME.md

  PaperMod ships an equivalent template at layouts/_default/llms.txt, but
  PaperMod is optional here. Without one of its own, a Foundation site with no
  base theme declares the `llms` output format in hugo.yaml and gets nothing to
  render it, which Hugo reports as "found no layout file for llms for kind
  home". A warning about a missing file trains people to ignore build output,
  and this one was free to remove: the Foundation can render its own llms.txt.

  Removing it did not leave a no-base-theme build silent. That build still warns
  once, "found no layout file for html for kind section", because no type ships
  a list.html yet — see docs/BASE-THEME.md §3. The claim that this template was
  the last warning standing was true of the llms file and wrong about the build.

  Emits absolute permalinks, which is the point: a crawler gets resolvable
  URLs. The section walk is recursive, so a site that nests needs no second
  file.

  Line breaks are produced with explicit "\n" in printf rather than by relying
  on template whitespace. The obvious `{{ range }}` / `{{- if }}` form looks
  equivalent and is not: the trim markers eat the newline after the heading and
  the output reads "# Articles- [Start here](...)".
*/ -}}
{{- define "fn-llms-section" -}}
  {{- $section := .section -}}
  {{- $depth := .depth -}}
  {{- if or (gt (len $section.RegularPages) 0) (gt (len $section.Sections) 0) -}}
    {{- $hashes := strings.Repeat (add $depth 1) "#" -}}
    {{- printf "\n%s %s\n\n" $hashes $section.Title -}}
    {{- range $p := $section.RegularPages -}}
      {{- if not (or $p.Params.searchHidden (eq $p.Layout `archives`) (eq $p.Layout `search`)) -}}
        {{- printf "- [%s](%s)\n" $p.Title $p.Permalink -}}
      {{- end -}}
    {{- end -}}
    {{- range $sub := $section.Sections -}}
      {{- template "fn-llms-section" (dict "section" $sub "depth" (add $depth 1)) -}}
    {{- end -}}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- printf "# %s\n\n" site.Title -}}
{{- with site.Params.description -}}
  {{- printf "%s\n\n" . -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $p := where site.RegularPages "Section" "" -}}
  {{- if not (or $p.Params.searchHidden (eq $p.Layout `archives`) (eq $p.Layout `search`) $p.IsHome) -}}
    {{- printf "- [%s](%s)\n" $p.Title $p.Permalink -}}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range site.Sections -}}
  {{- template "fn-llms-section" (dict "section" . "depth" 0) -}}
{{- end -}}
